about: Updates from operators who have joined YaanBook. 'aircraft' entries override the DGCA data for that registration (base airport code, current location, real hourly rate in INR before GST, seats, or available:false to hide it). 'emptyLegs' are discounted one-way repositioning flights; remove 'sample' once a listing is real. 'operators' lists company names (exactly as on the DGCA list) shown with a partner badge.
